reference_resolution_gate.method: For each width and grid, evaluate the exact MMS at OpenFOAM cell centers, then apply the same periodic centered-FD2 diagnostics used on solver fields. classification.REPRODUCED: For a fixed envelope power, both n=64 and n=128 pass standard acceptance and fail local quality, and both exact-reference FD2 floors pass the resolution gate.
classification.NOT_OBSERVED: For a fixed envelope power, both n=64 and n=128 pass standard acceptance and local quality, and both exact-reference FD2 floors pass the resolution gate.

interpretation_limits: A coarse-grid local-quality failure indicates resolution sensitivity, not a software defect.
A reproduced result concerns this frozen manufactured-solution matrix only.
No conclusion about molecular alignment, deterministic molecular positions, phase transition, viscosity collapse, real-fluid breakdown, or Navier-Stokes blow-up is permitted.
The OpenFOAM solver output itself remains fallible; preserve inputs, source/image hashes, residual histories, and sampled fields, and compare to the independent analytic reference.
